measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near its centre: diameter of each, and centre-to-centre distance between them (and whether they sit symmetrically either side of the board's centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: tallest thing sticking out of its back face (the 4-pin connector with its plug in), how far it sticks out, and how far its centre is from the board's centre
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, and its thickness
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the four corner holes: hole diameter, and centre-to-centre spacing along the long side and along the short side
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: height of the tallest part above the perfboard's top face, and the depth of anything (solder joints, pins) under its bottom face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: ESP32 USB-C port on the perfboard
measures.what: which perfboard edge it faces, how far the port mouth is past (or short of) that edge, how far the port's centre is from the perfboard's centreline along that edge, and the height of the port's centre above the perfboard's top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: the two wall screws you'll hang it on
measures.what: head diameter, shank diameter, and the spacing between them if they're already in the wall
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: does the USB-C port face one of the short (50 mm) edges or one of the long (70 mm) edges? And how far is the ESP32's centreline from the perfboard's centreline, measured along that edge
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: anything on its back face (connector, components): what it is, how far it sticks out from the back, and how far from the board's centre; plus where the input wires leave (distance from centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: thickness of the board at its edge (or the length of the M3 screws you'd like to use)
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: does the end of the ESP32 board with the USB-C port hang out past the perfboard's edge (by 7.53 mm), or sit 7.53 mm inside it? Is that a 50 mm edge or a 70 mm edge? And measured along that edge, how far is the ESP32's centreline from the perfboard's centreline (or: distance from the ESP32's long side to the nearest perfboard long edge)?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

limitations.wanted: Clear answers on where the ESP32's USB-C port sits on the perfboard (does it hang past the edge or sit inside it, and how far off centre sideways), plus the perfboard's thickness, the disc's thickness and where the disc's connector is
limitations.blocked_by: The measurement answers kept repeating the same ambiguous readings
limitations.why: The port opening has to line up with the port. I had to make the opening big enough to cover both readings instead of a tight cut-out.
